output.summary: A genus of herbaceous flowering plants whose species are variously native to Latin America, Australia, New Zealand, Papuasia, Hawaii, island Southeast Asia, eastern Africa and Madagascar. Leaf size varies dramatically: subgenus Panke contains giants, while others are low, mat-forming plants with small leaves. At least some species form an unusual intracellular partnership with nitrogen-fixing cyanobacteria.
output.edibilityNote: Stalks of some species are edible; G. tinctoria stalks are peeled and eaten fresh or prepared in salads, liquor or marmalade.
